title: Grade 4 ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — Mock Exam #8

pages.quiz:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION
TIME ALLOWED: 90 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 80
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What did the Prophet (S.A.W.) do before sleeping according to Aisha (R.A.)? (1 mark)
   A. Slept without any remembrance
   B. Blew into his hands after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas and wiped his body
   C. Recited Al-Masad three times
   D. Recited only Al-Fatiha standing

2. Which surah speaks about Abu Lahab? (1 mark)
   A. An-Nasr
   B. Al-Falaq
   C. Al-Fatiha
   D. Al-Masad

3. Which surah has only three verses? (1 mark)
   A. Al-Kafirun
   B. Al-Masad
   C. Al-Ikhlas
   D. An-Nasr

4. What did the Prophet say about smiling at your brother? (1 mark)
   A. It is only for the rich
   B. It is forbidden
   C. It is a kind of charity
   D. It is a sin

5. Why should Muslims not overeat? (1 mark)
   A. It can make us sick and lazy
   B. It is a sport
   C. It makes us fast
   D. It saves money

6. What should a Muslim say before eating? (1 mark)
   A. Alhamdulillah
   B. Subhanallah
   C. Astaghfirullah
   D. Bismillah

7. Who does the hadith in Muslim say is better and more beloved to Allah? (1 mark)
   A. The tall person
   B. The rich person
   C. The weak believer
   D. The strong believer

8. Which two names come from the word "rahmah"? (1 mark)
   A. Ar-Rahman and Al-Malik
   B. Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   C. As-Sami' and Al-Basir
   D. Al-Malik and As-Salam

9. What should we remember when we think of Israfil? (1 mark)
   A. The Day of Judgement is true
   B. Rain will stop
   C. We must fear dogs
   D. Prayer is not needed

10. What is the main tool for removing najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. Oil
   B. Paint
   C. Perfume
   D. Pure water

11. "Taahir" means (1 mark)
   A. Pure and clean
   B. Impure
   C. Prayer
   D. Fasting

12. Which is a health reason for washing away najasaat? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us taller
   B. It stops rain
   C. It makes food taste sweet
   D. It prevents diseases like diarrhoea

13. Which health benefit does wudhu give? (1 mark)
   A. It makes us thirsty
   B. It removes germs from exposed body parts
   C. It stops hunger
   D. It causes sleep

14. How many sujud are in each rak'ah? (1 mark)
   A. Four
   B. Three
   C. Two
   D. One

15. Which of these is a Sunnah act, not a pillar? (1 mark)
   A. Sujud
   B. Raising hands with the first takbir
   C. Fatiha
   D. Ruku

16. Which action shows cruelty? (1 mark)
   A. Watering a cow
   B. Throwing stones at a bird
   C. Giving shade
   D. Feeding a goat

17. What is a kofia? (1 mark)
   A. A cap
   B. A shoe
   C. A coat
   D. A belt

18. Which is an example of wasteful dressing? (1 mark)
   A. Buying many clothes you do not need
   B. Washing your clothes
   C. Sharing old clothes
   D. Repairing a shirt

19. Which of these is internet media? (1 mark)
   A. A book
   B. A poster
   C. A newspaper
   D. A video website

20. What should you do with a message saying school is closed if you are not sure? (1 mark)
   A. Delete school
   B. Forward it at once
   C. Check first
   D. Ignore parents

21. How should we give sadaqah? (1 mark)
   A. With shame
   B. With insults
   C. Quietly and kindly
   D. Loudly to embarrass

22. What is begging? (1 mark)
   A. Saving
   B. Farming
   C. Asking for money or things without real need
   D. Working

23. What does Qur'an 93:10 say about the one who asks? (1 mark)
   A. Do not drive him away
   B. Ignore him
   C. Laugh at him
   D. Shout at him

24. What do we say when leaving the house? (1 mark)
   A. Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   B. Alhamdulillah only
   C. Bismillahi walajna
   D. Amin only

25. When should you say the dua for leaving? (1 mark)
   A. As you step out of the door
   B. At night only
   C. After meals
   D. When going to bed

26. Who does the dua protect from harm? (1 mark)
   A. Only adults
   B. Nobody
   C. The one who says it, by Allah's will
   D. Only animals

27. How should parents correct children? (1 mark)
   A. With cruelty
   B. By ignoring
   C. By insults
   D. With wisdom and gentleness

28. About how old was the Prophet at the first revelation? (1 mark)
   A. About sixty
   B. About twenty
   C. About ten
   D. About forty

29. How did the leaders of Taif respond? (1 mark)
   A. They accepted at once
   B. They gave him gifts
   C. They joined him
   D. They rejected him rudely

30. What did some people of Taif do as he left? (1 mark)
   A. Followed him
   B. Cheered him
   C. Threw stones at him
   D. Gave him food

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
31. Describe one complete rak'ah in order. (4 marks)

32. What do we say in ruku, in sujud and when sitting between the two sujud? (3 marks)

33. Write a short thank-you note to a parent with two promises about helping at home. (5 marks)

34. Explain why we should be kind to Allah's creatures. (4 marks)

35. Name the seven parts of the body that touch the ground in sujud. (3 marks)

36. Give two good habits that keep a toothbrush healthy. (2 marks)

37. Explain how the Prophet (S.A.W.) showed love to children. (3 marks)

38. Explain how Islamic cleanliness rules protect health. (4 marks)

39. Explain why we should behave well even when nobody is watching. (2 marks)

40. Name the first and the last prophet. (2 marks)

41. Name three types of Muslim clothing worn in Kenya. (3 marks)

42. Explain what a person should do if they do not like a food served to them. (3 marks)

43. What must a boy and what must a girl cover in prayer at the least? (3 marks)

44. Describe what happened to Taif in later years. (3 marks)

45. Describe how the Prophet (S.A.W.) solved the dispute over placing the Black Stone. (3 marks)

46. State three rules for using working animals safely. (3 marks)
pages.answers:
ISLAMIC RELIGIOUS EDUCATION — MOCK EXAM #8 · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. B — Blew into his hands after reciting Al-Ikhlas, Al-Falaq and An-Naas and wiped his body
   This is reported in Al-Bukhari.

2. D — Al-Masad
   Al-Masad warns Abu Lahab, whose wealth did not save him.

3. D — An-Nasr
   An-Nasr is the shortest of the seven surahs in this lesson, with three verses.

4. C — It is a kind of charity
   A smile that cheers someone up is charity.

5. A — It can make us sick and lazy
   Moderation keeps us healthy.

6. D — Bismillah
   We begin by mentioning Allah's name.

7. D — The strong believer
   Both have good, but the strong believer is more beloved.

8. B — Ar-Rahman and Ar-Rahim
   Rahmah means mercy.

9. A — The Day of Judgement is true
   The Trumpet will be blown by Allah's command.

10. D — Pure water
   Allah sends pure water from the sky.

11. A — Pure and clean
   Taahir is the opposite of najis.

12. D — It prevents diseases like diarrhoea
   Cleanliness prevents germs.

13. B — It removes germs from exposed body parts
   Washing keeps us clean.

14. C — Two
   Each rak'ah has two sujud.

15. B — Raising hands with the first takbir
   Sunnah acts add reward.

16. B — Throwing stones at a bird
   Harming animals for fun is wrong.

17. A — A cap
   A kofia is a cap.

18. A — Buying many clothes you do not need
   Waste is disliked.

19. D — A video website
   The internet carries websites and videos.

20. C — Check first
   Verify news.

21. C — Quietly and kindly
   Protect dignity.

22. C — Asking for money or things without real need
   Begging is asking without need.

23. A — Do not drive him away
   We should be kind.

24. A — Bismillah, tawakkaltu 'alallah, wa la hawla wa la quwwata illa billah
   This is the dua for leaving.

25. A — As you step out of the door
   At the time of leaving.

26. C — The one who says it, by Allah's will
   Allah protects.

27. D — With wisdom and gentleness
   Islam forbids cruelty.

28. D — About forty
   He was about forty.

29. D — They rejected him rudely
   They refused.

30. C — Threw stones at him
   His feet were hurt.

SECTION B
----
31. (4 marks)
   Answer: Stand and recite Al-Fatiha, bow, rise, first sujud, sit, second sujud, then stand or sit for tashahhud.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each pair of steps.

32. (3 marks)
   Answer: Ruku: Subhana Rabbiyal Azim; sujud: Subhana Rabbiyal A'la; sitting: Rabbighfir li.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

33. (5 marks)
   Answer: A polite note thanking the parent for specific things, and two clear promises such as washing dishes and doing homework early.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for greeting and thanks, 2 marks for specific thanks, 2 marks for two promises.

34. (4 marks)
   Answer: Allah made them and owns them; kindness earns mercy and reward; animals help us; kindness makes us kind to people.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid reason.

35. (3 marks)
   Answer: Forehead with nose, two palms, two knees and toes of both feet.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for forehead, 1 mark for palms and knees, 1 mark for toes.

36. (2 marks)
   Answer: Do not share it and change it when the bristles are bent.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each habit.

37. (3 marks)
   Answer: He kissed and hugged them, including his grandson Al-Hasan, and said that those who show no mercy will not be shown mercy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

38. (4 marks)
   Answer: They prevent germs and diseases like diarrhoea and cholera. They teach washing hands after the toilet and before meals, and keep places clean.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid point up to 4.

39. (2 marks)
   Answer: Allah is Al-Basir and sees everything, and As-Sami' hears everything.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for Allah sees and hears and 1 mark for good behaviour.

40. (2 marks)
   Answer: Adam was the first and Muhammad (S.A.W.) was the last.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

41. (3 marks)
   Answer: Kanzu, kofia, hijab or headscarf, buibui, long dress.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each.

42. (3 marks)
   Answer: Leave it quietly and politely without criticising, as the Prophet did, and thank the person.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for not criticising, 1 mark for quietness or politeness, 1 mark for thanks.

43. (3 marks)
   Answer: A boy must cover from the navel to the knees. A girl must cover the whole body except the face and hands.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the boy, 1 mark for the girl, 1 mark for the general rule of modest clothes.

44. (3 marks)
   Answer: In later years its people accepted Islam, and many descendants of those who rejected the Prophet became Muslims.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each of the points.

45. (3 marks)
   Answer: He placed the stone on a cloak and asked a leader from each tribe to hold an edge and lift it together, then he set it in place.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the cloak, 1 mark for leaders lifting together, 1 mark for setting it in place.

46. (3 marks)
   Answer: Do not overload, give water and rest, do not beat, keep them healthy.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each rule.
